indicators: S3 bucket policy allowing Principal "*" with GetObject and ListBucket actions
CloudTrail logs showing 'Anonymous' user performing ListObjectsV2 on sensitive bucket
AWS CLI commands successfully listing bucket contents without authentication
HTTP 200 responses for GET requests to bucket objects without authorization
Source IPs outside corporate IP range accessing the bucket
examples.detection_method: Deploy automated CSPM tools to continuously audit S3 bucket policies for public access permissions. Monitor CloudTrail logs for anonymous or unauthorized ListObjects and GetObject API calls. Alert on any S3 API calls originating from IP addresses not whitelisted or without valid IAM credentials. Use AWS Config rules such as s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited to block or alert on buckets with public read permissions.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (Anonymous access in cloud storage)
T1552.001 - Credentials in Files (exfiltration via publicly accessible bucket)
